usageNotes: Use this to audit or monitor background task activity across all PDM-managed remotes (Proxmox Backup Server nodes). Filter by remote ID to scope results to a single remote, or combine `running: true` with a `typefilter` (e.g. 'sync') to watch live sync jobs. Results default to 50 tasks ordered by start time descending; set `limit: 0` to retrieve all tasks, but prefer `since`/`until` bounds on busy remotes to avoid large payloads.

examples.summary: List the last 20 failed tasks on a specific remote since the start of the month

tips: Use `running: true` to poll for active sync or verify jobs before triggering a new one — PDM may queue or reject duplicate runs.
The `upid` field in each result is the Unique Process ID; pass it to the PDM task log endpoint to retrieve full task output.
`statusfilter` is an array of status strings (e.g. ['error', 'warning']); an empty array behaves as no filter.
`typefilter` is a substring match against worker_type, so 'sync' will match 'sync', 'pull-sync', etc.
Pagination is controlled by `start` + `limit`; iterate by incrementing `start` by `limit` until fewer results than `limit` are returned.
